# T013.fix1 — Patch CLI cookie through its compatible parent

## Summary

On 2026-10-21 UTC, Node 24.21.0 / npm 11.19.0, updated the development-only Static Web Apps CLI lock from 2.0.7 to the lowest compatible patched-parent release, 2.0.9. Its `cookie` requirement moved from `^0.5.0` to `^0.7.0`; npm resolved the shared root copy to 0.7.2. The original three offline cookie characterization assertions passed before and after the upgrade; the full suite retained 38 passing tests. T013 was checkpointed before this fix-up to clear the current-task lock.

## Changes (files and why)

- `frontend/package.json`: raise the CLI minimum from `^2.0.7` to `^2.0.9` so clean future installs cannot select the vulnerable parent.
- `package-lock.json`: npm-managed 2.0.9 CLI and 0.7.2 cookie; npm deduplicated the already-patched Express copy into the root copy. No other package versions changed.
- `frontend/tests/swa-cli-cookie.test.ts`: retain TestAuthor's pre-update characterization of Set-Cookie flags/encoding, parsing/chunks, and logout expiry without weakening assertions; passed unchanged on both CLI versions. This file was untracked when this fix-up began.
- This progress note. No ACS/config/deployment files changed.

## Decisions (rationale and sources)

The [GitHub advisory GHSA-pxg6-pf52-xh8x](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-pxg6-pf52-xh8x), checked 2026-10-21, describes crafted cookie name/path/domain fields altering serialization and identifies 0.7.0 as first patched. The repository's npm audit scanner corroborated the original CLI path; `npm explain cookie` and published `npm view @azure/static-web-apps-cli@2.0.9 engines dependencies --json` confirm the new parent permits `^0.7.0` and Node >=18/npm >=9. Kept the manifest's existing caret convention with a raised minimum and locked the lowest eligible CLI; avoided cross-range overrides or blanket audit fix. The CLI handles local development HTTP cookies, so developer-facing requests can plausibly reach cookie handling; no deployment was exercised.

| Advisory | Severity | Package | From | To | Direct/transitive | Status | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GHSA-pxg6-pf52-xh8x | low | cookie | 0.5.0 | 0.7.2 (first patched 0.7.0) | transitive via direct frontend dev CLI 2.0.7 → 2.0.9 | fixed in root lock | GitHub advisory; npm lock diff, `npm explain cookie`, root scan no longer lists cookie |

The standalone backend Express cookie remains 0.7.1 and is separately patched. The npm scanner (npm 11.19.0, 2026-10-21) still reports root 12 affected names (2 critical, 8 high, 1 moderate, 1 low), down from 13 (2/8/1/2); backend remains 3 high names. These are affected package *names*, not independent advisory totals. No new affected names appeared. The inherited CLI high finding (ZIP/node-forge/tmp paths), Vitest/tinypool, and backend watcher findings remain open as detailed in T013; no owner acceptance was inferred.

## Validation (commands and results)

Environment: Linux, Node v24.21.0, npm 11.19.0; `CI=true TZ=UTC LANG=C.UTF-8` on the exact gates after the dependency edit.

- Before upgrade, `npm exec --workspace frontend -- vitest run --config vitest.config.ts tests/swa-cli-cookie.test.ts`: 3 passed; `./node_modules/.bin/swa --version` 2.0.7 and offline `--help` succeeded.
- After upgrade, same cookie command: 3 passed unchanged; CLI 2.0.9 `--version` and offline `--help` succeeded with the same commands and options, apart from displayed version.
- `CI=true TZ=UTC LANG=C.UTF-8 npm ci`: pass.
- `CI=true TZ=UTC LANG=C.UTF-8 npm run build --if-present`: pass, pre-existing three CSS optimizer warnings.
- `CI=true TZ=UTC LANG=C.UTF-8 npm test`: 15 backend + 23 frontend = **38 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped**. An initial run overlapped with `npm ci --prefix backend` and lost seven server tests when the installation replaced backend dependencies; rerun after the install finished was green. Do not run backend clean install concurrently with tests.
- `CI=true TZ=UTC LANG=C.UTF-8 npm run lint --if-present`: pass, existing five warnings, zero errors.
- `CI=true TZ=UTC LANG=C.UTF-8 npm ci --prefix backend`: pass.
- `CI=true TZ=UTC LANG=C.UTF-8 bash /shared/skills/dependency-vulnerability-remediation/scripts/scan-dependencies.sh --output-dir .modernization-scratch/scan .`: exit **2**, completed scans with residual findings, not an incomplete scan. Baseline scan had cookie and root 13 names; post-upgrade scan no cookie and root 12 names, backend still 3. Raw evidence is local-only in `.modernization-scratch/scan`.

## Follow-ups and risks

- Do not treat exit 2 as clean or accept the remaining findings silently; see T013 for individual advisory IDs, parent graphs, and required owner decisions. The CLI is a deployment tool, but only offline help/version and local cookie behavior were checked; deployment/Azure behavior remains unverified. No live requests, credentials, ACS, or config were changed.
- npm's existing install-script and deprecation notices and existing CSS/lint warnings persist; no gates, tests, or warnings were suppressed.
